captions.caption: A low-angle shot looks up through the dense, green canopy of a forest.
The camera tilts down through the forest trees, revealing the ground.
A plume of white smoke rises from a small fire in a clearing.
A wide shot shows the small, smoky fire in the middle of a forest clearing.
Smoke continues to billow from the small fire on the forest floor.
A wide view of the smoky fire in the middle of the lush green forest.
In a new scene, a shirtless man begins chopping a small tree with a stone axe.
The man swings the stone axe repeatedly, striking the tree.
He continues to chop at the base of the small tree with the axe.
He repeatedly strikes the tree with the stone axe.
The man continues to chop at the tree with rhythmic swings of the axe.
He continues chopping the tree while kneeling on the ground.
He swings the stone axe powerfully, chipping away at the tree trunk.
He continues to chop at the same spot on the tree.
The man raises the stone axe and brings it down on the tree.
He continues to swing the axe, making progress on cutting down the tree.
He chops at the other side of the tree to complete the cut.
He continues chopping the tree with the stone axe.
The man stands and pushes the partially cut tree, causing it to fall.
He holds the fallen tree trunk after pushing it over.
In a new scene, a man lifts a long wooden pole onto his shoulder.
He begins walking through the forest, carrying the pole on his shoulder.
The man continues walking through the dense forest with the wooden pole.
The man walks out of the frame, carrying the pole.
In a new scene, a man hammers a wooden post into the ground using a large, flat rock.
He continues to strike the top of the wooden post with the rock.
He puts the rock down and grabs the post with both hands.
He pushes and twists the wooden post to drive it further into the ground.
He continues to work the post into the ground.
The man stands up another large wooden post vertically in the ground.
He positions the post, preparing to build a structure.
In a new scene, the man is tying a horizontal pole to a vertical post with vines.
He continues to lash the pole to the post, creating a frame.
He walks to the other side of the structure to secure the other end.
He ties the other end of the horizontal pole to a second vertical post.
He finishes securing the horizontal pole with vine lashings.
He walks back to the center of the frame he has built.
He places a long pole across the top of the two vertical posts.
He begins to tie the top crossbeam to the vertical posts.
Having secured the crossbeam, he steps back to assess the frame.
He picks up another long pole to add to the structure.
He leans a pole diagonally against the top crossbeam to form part of the roof.
He secures the diagonal roof pole to the crossbeam with vine.
He lifts another long pole to add to the other side of the roof frame.
The man stands on a small wooden support, tying poles together at the peak of the roof.
He continues to lash the poles together at the apex of the A-frame roof.
He carefully wraps the vine around the joined poles at the roof's peak.
He continues to secure the top of the roof frame with more vine lashing.
He pulls the vine tight to ensure the structure is secure.
He works on the final knots to secure the roof's peak.
He finishes tying the lashing at the apex of the wooden frame.
A wide shot shows the completed wooden A-frame of the shelter.
The finished wooden frame stands in the forest clearing.
The shot holds on the completed hut frame, showing the lashed joints.
A steady shot of the wooden skeleton of the shelter in the forest.
In a new scene, a man strips large green leaves off a branch with a stone tool.
He pulls a large frond of leaves toward himself.
He continues to strip individual leaves off the main stem.
He uses a small stone tool to help remove the leaves from the palm frond.
In a new scene, a man holds up a large palm frond, preparing to use it for thatching.

thoughts:
**Here's how I'm approaching this captioning task.**

First, I need to understand the task. The user wants a JSON array with captions for each second of a video, specifically the first minute. I need to generate 60 captions, each describing what's visible in that particular second. They need to be concise, self-contained, and detailed enough for someone who hasn't seen the video. And, of course, the output must be a single, valid JSON array.

To start, I'll watch the video and write down a description for each one-second interval. It is critical to note exactly what is happening in each second, because the user explicitly stated that the caption must be an accurate representation of the events.  I will then structure the timecodes to be accurate and precisely formatted.  I will handle any potential errors by using "ERROR" as the caption.

With all the components, the user will have a completely compliant JSON array. I'll make sure there are exactly 60 captions and that they are in the correct format with the correct timecodes before I deliver the JSON array.
